## Portfolio & Case Studies (18 Real-World Outcomes)
1. [CFO Office & RO 3M Fundraising Advisory](https://omangrowth.com/projects/cfo-office-ro3m.html)
   - *Impact:* Prepared board-ready financial model and institutional pitch, securing RO 3,000,000 growth equity for an Omani industrial SME.
2. [AI Automation for Sohar Manufacturing](https://omangrowth.com/projects/ai-automation-sohar.html)
   - *Impact:* Automated procure-to-pay workflow with RPA, reducing cycle time from 12 days to 2 days while saving 450 hours per month.
3. [Port Logistics & Freight Forwarding Digital Control Tower (Sohar Port)](https://omangrowth.com/projects/sohar-port-logistics-control-tower.html)
   - *Impact:* Built integrated digital control tower at Sohar Port & Freezone, reducing demurrage penalties by 38% across maritime supply chains.
4. [Dhofar Logistics & Cold Chain Optimization](https://omangrowth.com/projects/dhofar-logistics.html)
   - *Impact:* Overhauled warehousing and multi-modal fleet dispatch in Salalah corridor, delivering 30% cost reduction and Vision 2040 hub readiness.
5. [Risk, Governance & Compliance Architecture for GLC](https://omangrowth.com/projects/risk-compliance-glc.html)
   - *Impact:* Designed enterprise risk framework meeting Oman National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) and Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) requirements.
6. [Cross-Border eCommerce & Omnichannel Retail (Muscat-Dubai)](https://omangrowth.com/projects/cross-border-ecommerce-muscat-dubai.html)
   - *Impact:* Integrated warehousing, customs clearance, and same-day delivery between Muscat and Dubai, tripling cross-border transaction volume.
7. [Retail Digital Modernization & eCommerce Growth (Muscat)](https://omangrowth.com/projects/digital-business-muscat-retail.html)
   - *Impact:* Scaled online revenue share from 8% to 40% in 12 months for a premier Muscat retail conglomerate.
8. [Agri-Tech & Food Security Cold Chain Advisory (Al Batinah)](https://omangrowth.com/projects/agri-tech-cold-chain-batinah.html)
   - *Impact:* Designed temperature-controlled cold chain logistics framework reducing post-harvest wastage by 24% in line with national food security targets.
9. [Green Hydrogen & Clean Energy Industrial Feasibility (Duqm SEZ)](https://omangrowth.com/projects/green-hydrogen-duqm-feasibility.html)
